hints.title: Temporal Batching
hints.text: Meetings occurring at the exact same timestamp share secrets simultaneously, but secrets cannot travel backwards in time.

hints.title: Local Graph Propagation
hints.text: Build an adjacency list for each discrete timestamp containing only the individuals interacting at that moment.

hints.title: Multi-Source Component Traversal
hints.text: Initialize a queue with all participants of that timestamp who already know the secret and expand to connected peers.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(M log M + M + N) sorting meetings and local breadth-first search
complexity.space: O(M + N) adjacency list and visited states
complexity.notes: Meetings at the exact same timestamp allow instantaneous bidirectional secret transmission.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Global union find without resetting disconnected elements incorrectly propagates secrets across earlier or later times.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping meetings by time restricts graph traversals to local batches.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should group meetings by time and propagate secrets only within concurrent components.
